news.title: Jamal Murray, Nikola Jokic lead Nuggets to 123-118 win over Grizzlies
news.text: — Jamal Murray scored 17 of his 30 points in the fourth quarter, Nikola Jokic added 27 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Memphis Grizzlies 123-118 on Wednesday night.

news.title: Jerome scores 27 points as Grizzlies improve to 5-0 on road by routing short-handed Raptors 118-102
news.text: — Ty Jerome scored 27 points, Cameron Boozer added 22 and the Memphis Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the road this season by beating the short-handed Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday night.

news.title: Williamson's 25 points, free throws by Fears, give Pelicans 135-134 win over Grizzlies in overtime
news.text: — Zion Williamson scored 25 points including nine in overtime, Jeremiah Fears hit two free throws with 7.3 seconds left, and the New Orleans Pelicans handed the Memphis Grizzlies their first loss of the season, 135-134 on Monday night.

news.title: Boozer, Stewart lead Memphis to a 136-105 victory over Kings as Grizzlies remain unbeaten
news.text: — Rookie Cameron Boozer had 27 points and nine rebounds, Isaiah Stewart added 24 points as the Memphis Grizzlies remained the only unbeaten team in the NBA with a 136-105 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Saturday night.

news.title: Ja Morant out at least 4 weeks with hamstring strain suffered against Grizzlies
news.text: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out for at least four weeks.

news.title: Trail Blazers' Ja Morant exits first game vs. Grizzlies with hamstring injury
news.text: Ja Morant exited his first game against his former team in the fourth quarter Thursday night because of a left hamstring injury.

news.title: Boozer posts first career triple-double in Grizzlies win over Blazers
news.text: — Cameron Boozer had the first triple-double of his NBA career with 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists, and the Memphis Grizzlies beat the Portland Trail Blazers 124-103 on Thursday night to move to 5-0.
